events.title: “640K ought to be enough for anybody”
events.summary: One of computing’s most repeated quotes — and one of its most disputed attributions.

narrative.whyChosen: It captures how every generation underestimates the next wave of resource demand.
narrative.whyImportant: The quote became shorthand for bad forecasting in tech, even though its authorship is questionable.
narrative.problemSolved: It did not solve a problem — it documents a recurring industry blind spot about growth.

sources.title: Snopes — Did Bill Gates say 640K is enough?
